name: Robotics Engineering Minor
notes: Carried over from the old planner (2025-26 hand-typed data). Not checked against the 2026-27 catalog.
The old data required a 2.5 GPA and a C or better in every minor course, and at least one core elective from outside your major's department. Those two conditions are not evaluated here.
The old data also listed ME 3133 and CSC 4444 as core electives; neither has a known catalog record, so they are left out. Assign a course to a slot by hand if an advisor approves one.
